nodes.summary: Rust package manifest: name oxiguitar-plugin-manager, edition 2024, version 0.1.0. Dependencies: oxiguitar-plugin (interface 1.15), oxiguitar-plugin-test (dev), semver, sha2, tar, ureq, zip. Features: oxp (enables tar dependency for OxiGuitar plugin archive format). Build dependencies: oxiguitar-plugin/build. Workspace excluded.

nodes.summary: Build script that compiles the plugin as a .oxp archive: runs cargo build with oxp feature, then packages the library with manifest.json into a tar archive following the OxiGuitar plugin file format.
